premium.disclosure: Premium subscriptions are processed by RevenueCat and, for purchases made on the web, Stripe. CoutureCast shares your account id and purchase state with these processors so your subscription works everywhere you sign in. Card numbers are handled by the payment provider and never reach CoutureCast.

theme.disclosure: Interface palettes are a Premium feature. Your choice is saved to your CoutureCast account and applies on every device you sign in on. A palette changes colours only: it never changes which outfits are recommended. CoutureCast sends the palette you picked to its analytics provider under a pseudonymous id; no wardrobe photos or personal details are shared.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.body: This card uses the palette you have applied. The cards above always show their own colours.

theme.unavailable: Palettes are switched off for now. Your saved choice is kept and comes back when they return.

palette.intro: Find the makeup shades and accessories that suit your tones. Premium reads your wardrobe colours, or one selfie you choose to share, and keeps only the result.

consent.title: Colour analysis consent
consent.body: CoutureCast only reads an image after you say yes here. A selfie is analysed on CoutureCast's servers and the photo is deleted the moment the analysis finishes, success or failure; only your undertone, your depth and a confidence score are kept. Withdraw consent at any time and everything derived from it is erased too.
consent.revoke: Withdraw consent and erase my palette

source.selfieHint: One centred, evenly lit, unfiltered photo of your face gives both an undertone and a depth. The photo is deleted as soon as the analysis ends.
source.wardrobeHint: No upload needed. CoutureCast reads the colours already stored for your garments and reports an undertone only.

failure.noFace: We could not find enough skin tone in that photo. Try a centred, evenly lit shot with your face filling the frame.
failure.lowQuality: That photo was too dim, too filtered or too uneven to read confidently. Try again in even daylight without filters.
failure.privacyViolation: That photo cannot be analysed. Choose a different photo of yourself.
failure.insufficientWardrobe: Your wardrobe does not have enough colourful garments yet. Add a few more, or use a selfie instead.
failure.timeout: The analysis took too long and was stopped. Try again in a moment.
failure.storageError: We could not read the uploaded photo. Try again.

palette.foundationDepthUnknown: Wardrobe colours show your undertone but not your skin depth, so foundation is a shade family rather than an exact match. A selfie would narrow it to one shade.

sponsored.disclosure: Sponsored. CoutureCast earns a commission if you buy through this link. It does not change which shades are recommended, and you can turn sponsored links off in Settings.

palette.deleteConfirm: This erases your undertone, your depth, every saved and dismissed suggestion, and any photo still held. It cannot be undone.
